explanation: Fires on the first sub-word piece of an unusual, proper or compound word, usually just after a space or hyphen (Bell-Helms, S-charfstein, d-ailies, H-ASC, Met-News, Realtor(R), Simonsberg-Stellenbosch, revenue-sharing), including garbled words. A couple of digits inside multi-digit numbers and some ordinary web words also appear.
